# GitHub-native participation and automation
**Parent:** [root](../README.md) · **Status:** prototype.
- [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/README.md) provides human-readable browser forms.
- [workflows/](workflows/README.md) checks repository structure and converts new Markdown dropbox posts to GitHub Issues.

These configurations support normal GitHub use. They do not create an autonomous AI scheduler or confer normative authority. Maintenance: review workflow permissions/failed runs, track changes in PRs, and ensure a human can still participate without invoking a script.
